items.quote: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
items.claim: Moses objects to the LORD that he speaks poorly ('of uncircumcised lips') and asks how Pharaoh will listen to him.
items.mechanism: a speech impediment or lack of eloquence that he believes will stop Pharaoh from listening

items.quote: See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh
items.claim: The LORD tells Moses that He has made him 'a god to Pharaoh', meaning Moses will hold authority over Pharaoh.
items.mechanism: being given godlike standing makes up for Moses's weak speech

items.quote: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
items.claim: The LORD appoints Aaron, Moses's brother, to be Moses's prophet (his spokesman) before Pharaoh.
items.mechanism: Aaron speaks for Moses, which answers Moses's objection about his 'uncircumcised lips'
